name: visual-prompt
description: Generate grounded, non-repetitive image prompts by default, with explicitly enabled video/music prompts, strict source anchors, parent-only generation, and fail-closed quality gates for Vietnamese xianxia/wuxia novel files; the batch driver may opt into isolated runner-level Pass-2 workers (VP_WORKERS) and may scope runs via VP_NO_VIDEO/VP_NO_MUSIC/VP_GLOB without changing the default serial run or the default workflow; --lean opt-in swaps the ten-section deep prompt for a five-section spec (Subject/Setting/Action/Style/Negative) whose mode is fixed by the user invocation, not the model
